1339-3641-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-3641-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2557-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2021-2060-3129-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2866-3338-4096-5569--175.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice the artifact with mana value 0 and return Lantern of Insight from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning nothing to your hand.
Activate Lantern of Insight by tapping and sacrificing it.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning the artifact with mana value 0 from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lantern of Insight ability.
Cast the artifact with mana value 0 by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.

3276-5038-6798-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat as needed.

2829-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
2829-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2919-3129-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-3129-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1482-2866-3967-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4608-5400-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Synth Infiltrator.
4608-5400-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
4608-5400-5466.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Synth Infiltrator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Synth Infiltrator's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Synth Infiltrator's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Synth Infiltrator's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-2921-3000-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

632-1849-3621-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1849-3621-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

252-4779-5394.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2018-2921--73.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2018-2921--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

with a takeover counter on it

413-5326--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
413-5326--5--6.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When The Master enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

708-736-2459-5256.notablePrerequisites: Copy Enchantment is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-736-2459-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, accomplishing nothing.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

575-4050-4180.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
575-4050-4180.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Lands.
Repeat.

1636-2034-2204-2831.notablePrerequisites: Scholar of New Horizons does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2034-2204-2831.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage, adding {C}{C}.
Glen Elendra Archmage dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Glen Elendra Archmage enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Scholar of New Horizons by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from Glen Elendra Archmage, causing you to search your library for a Plains card and either put it onto the battlefield or put it into your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

1339-3394-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3394-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
